design_gotchas.title: Negative-Rail Input Headroom Limit and Legacy Phase Reversal Trap
design_gotchas.detail: Common-mode input includes VCC+ but requires (VCC-) + 4 V minimum headroom on current D-package specs (±11 V guaranteed at ±15 V). TL072IDR cannot sense signals near ground in 5 V single-supply LM358DR sockets, and legacy SFAB silicon exhibits output phase reversal when inputs approach VCC-.

design_gotchas.title: Mixed Legacy SFAB vs Modern RFB Die Shipping Under TL072IDR (Section 9.1.1)
design_gotchas.detail: Per Revision W Section 9.1.1, non-H suffix TL072IDR reels may contain either legacy SFAB or modern RFB die—shifting 1 kHz voltage noise from 18 nV/√Hz (legacy) to 37 nV/√Hz (new die), GBW from 3 MHz to 5.25 MHz, and adding ±10 mA rail-to-rail ESD input clamp diodes. Order TL072H if deterministic modern-die specs are required.

design_gotchas.title: Non-Rail-to-Rail Output Swing and Minimum ±10 V Legacy Supply Margin
design_gotchas.detail: Output swing is guaranteed to ±12 V min (±13.5 V typ) on ±15 V with RL = 10 kΩ (±10 V at RL = 2 kΩ). While new-die operation starts at 4.5 V, legacy SFAB lots require ≥10 V total supply, so do not rely on TL072IDR for 3.3 V or 5 V single-supply systems.

design_gotchas.title: Higher 1 kHz Audio Noise Floor vs OPA2134UA on Identical SOIC-8 Footprint
design_gotchas.detail: Although pin-compatible with OPA2134UA in SOIC-8, TL072IDR exhibits 37 nV/√Hz at 1 kHz (new die) vs 8 nV/√Hz on OPA2134UA and weaker low-impedance drive into 600 Ω pro-audio loads.

typical_use_cases: Split-supply (±12 V / ±15 V) audio mixers, active crossovers, and guitar pedals
High-voltage (up to 40 V) solar inverter, UPS, and servo motor drive feedback stages
High-impedance FET-input integrators, sample-and-hold, and instrumentation filters
High-slew-rate (20 V/µs) dual industrial analog signal conditioning in SOIC-8
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments TL072IDR is an industrial-grade (-40°C to +85°C), dual high-voltage FET-input operational amplifier in an 8-pin SOIC (D) package rated up to 40 V (42 V abs max) on current production specs. Offering 65 pA typical input bias current, 5.25 MHz GBWP, 20 V/µs slew rate, and 100 dB CMRR at 1.4 mA/ch Iq, it is a staple for ±12 V/±15 V audio and industrial circuits. Engineers must account for its non-rail-to-rail negative input headroom ((VCC-) + 4 V), legacy-to-new die transition under non-H OPNs (shifting 1 kHz noise to 37 nV/√Hz), and incompatibility with 5 V ground-sensing LM358 circuits.
